verdict: Ads are running and driving clicks; lead intake needs immediate repair.
narrative: This period, Google Ads delivered 45 conversions from 220 clicks on $120.08 in spend, but none of those contacts are appearing in your CRM — the issue points to a form or intake disconnect, not a drop in demand. Your Google Ads only went live October 27, so there is not yet enough history to judge cost-per-lead efficiency, but early click volume is encouraging. On the organic side, your two Google Business profiles generated 3,968 total actions this period — 386 calls, 1,555 direction requests, and 2,027 website clicks — though engagement dropped sharply in the final two days of the week, which is being looked into. We're repairing the lead intake connection now so that next period's conversions register in full, and the GBP drop is being checked this week.
